metadata.summary: This time limited state plan amendment responds COVID-19 emergency. The purpose of this amendment requests changes to cost sharing requirements for testing, quantity limits for DME and medical supplies, transportation requirements and covered laboratory services for beneficiaries covered under traditional Medicaid and the Alternative Benefit Plans. This also amends Telehealth policy and modification of face-to-face requirements, Pharmacy adjustments to quantity limits and prior authorization requirements for automatic renewal. Provider payment rates are increased under this amendment and modifies to person-centered planning requirements, Long-term care facility cost reporting and practitioner licensing requirements.
